▪︎alt: BID H2RA x8wks (cimetidine, famotidine, ranitidine); or daily PPI (omeprazole, esomeprazole, pantoprazole)

▪︎antacid relief <2hrs; H2RA onset >30min, relief up to 8hrs
Mild/intermittent (<2x/wk), ⍉erosive esophagitis/Barrett’s ⇢ low-dose H2RA (famotidine) PRN, reeval 4wks; continued Sx ⇢ standard-dose H2RA BID, reeval 2wks
Still Sx ⇢ stop H2RA, start PPI (omeprazole, pantoprazole) once daily; reeval 4-8wks
Severe/freq (>2x/wk) or erosive esophagitis/Barrett’s ⇢ standard-dose PPI daily; persistent ⇢ reinforce adherence/lifestyle, manage as refractory GERD
Improved on H2RA ⇢ ⇣ to PRN; PPI ⇢ taper & d/c after Sx-free 8wks (taper ⍉ for severe erosive esophagitis/Barrett’s)
Recurrence ≥3mo after stopping ⇢ 8wk course of previously effective tx; <3mo ⇢ EGD (if ⍉done) & long-term maintenance acid suppression
▪︎fundoplication: healthy pts w/ atypical Sx needing high-dose PPI; refuse or can't take long-term tx; large hiatal hernia w/ refractory Sx
▪︎one step further: morbid obesity w/ GERD Sx ⇢ bariatric surgery
